threats.name: Broken Access Control
threats.description: The application allows users to bypass intended security restrictions without appropriate authorization, potentially leading to data breaches.

threats.name: Injection Attacks
threats.description: Untrusted data is sent to an interpreter as part of a command or query. The attacker's hostile data can trick the interpreter into executing unintended commands.

threats.name: Cryptographic Failures
threats.description: Sensitive data exposure due to inadequate cryptographic protection, allowing attackers to access confidential information.

threats.name: Insecure Design
threats.description: Security issues due to design flaws in the application's architecture that leave it vulnerable to attacks.
